name: canvas-driver-lifecycle
description: The isolated Chromium lifecycle check of the Canvas browser harness, Tools/canvas-test/driver-lifecycle.mjs with its CDP driver Tools/canvas-test/driver.mjs, and its Jet twin, Tools/canvas-test/Run.jet driver-lifecycle, #5072 c3: COUNT Chromium sessions launch with isolated profiles, each answers, and each closes for good (the original also checks that a Chromium whose launch fails releases every pending CDP command and event). Each side's driver supplies the repository's pinned nixpkgs Chromium (and, for the twin, its chromedriver in a generated .jet/lock), or the browsers $CHROMIUM and $CHROMEDRIVER name.
